fact: The US International Trade Administration's country commercial guide states that data localisation is mandatory in Algeria, with data to be stored in-country, under Law No. 18-07, which came into force on 10 August 2023.
source_slug: 2024-09-19 Algeria Digital Economy (US Country Commercial Guide)

fact: Digital Policy Alert says the Regulatory Authority of Post and Electronic Communications issued a rule in November 2017 requiring public cloud computing operators to build infrastructure in Algeria and host and store data locally.
The same cloud localisation rule was issued by the Regulatory Authority of Post and Electronic Communications, which licenses cloud data hosting providers, per Digital Policy Alert.
Digital Policy Alert says the Law on Audiovisual Activity entered into force in December 2024, requiring online audiovisual services to be hosted on servers physically located in Algeria.
